decisions.options: A finite owner-approved duration; manual review without configured duration; explicitly disabled retention
decisions.technicalConsequence: TELEMETRY_RETENTION_DAYS accepts 1–36500 whole days (engineering bounds, not a recommendation). Missing value refuses time purge.
decisions.privacyResearchConsequence: Shorter retention reduces exposure; longer retention permits longitudinal/reproducibility work.
decisions.recommendedChoice: Select the shortest duration justified by the approved purpose; no numeric recommendation without that purpose.

decisions.options: Manual reviewed invocations; an externally scheduled authenticated job after separate approval
decisions.technicalConsequence: Only manual/disabled modes exist. No cron or scheduled Worker handler is installed.
decisions.privacyResearchConsequence: Manual review reduces accidental loss but requires accountable execution; scheduling improves consistency with added destructive operational risk.
decisions.recommendedChoice: Start with reviewed manual execution; approve scheduling separately if operational need is established.
decisions.implementationStatus: Manual mechanism ready; automatic activation intentionally absent.

decisions.options: One accountable POC custodian; limited authorized analyst custodians; optional separate maintenance credential
decisions.technicalConsequence: ADMIN_TOKEN permits all reads and, unless MAINTENANCE_TOKEN is configured, destructive routes. With separation, writes require both admin authentication and maintenance credential.
decisions.privacyResearchConsequence: Shared tokens provide no individual audit attribution and rotation affects all holders.
decisions.recommendedChoice: Limit ADMIN_TOKEN holders to named approved custodians; configure separate MAINTENANCE_TOKEN before sharing export access.
decisions.ownerSelection: Pending; no person or role assigned
decisions.implementationStatus: Authentication retained; optional capability separation implemented.

decisions.options: Retain under approved retention basis; review an authorized run-specific deletion request
decisions.technicalConsequence: Collection switch cancels pending events only. Admin run deletion is separate, previewable and confirmed. Late retries can recreate records.
decisions.privacyResearchConsequence: Immediate deletion can harm longitudinal integrity; retention despite opt-out requires transparent approved arrangements.
decisions.recommendedChoice: Explain accepted-data handling before use; provide a custodian-mediated process where appropriate, without promising identity lookup.
decisions.implementationStatus: Run deletion implemented; no automatic retrospective deletion.

decisions.options: Approved restricted repository with disposal register; other institution-approved research storage
decisions.technicalConsequence: D1 cannot delete arbitrary downloaded, submitted or backup copies. Hash-bound sidecar documents export context.
decisions.privacyResearchConsequence: Extra copies enlarge access/retention scope and need recipient accountability.
decisions.recommendedChoice: Minimize copies and recipients; track custody and apply the approved disposal schedule to each location.
decisions.implementationStatus: Custody guide and export sidecar ready; no invented institutional storage rule.

decisions.options: Retain provided factual description; adapt course/study notice under institutional procedures
decisions.technicalConsequence: Public/default Composer remains local-only; local download alone does not submit. Browser site-data removal can erase progress.
decisions.privacyResearchConsequence: Shared browser profiles expose local records; submissions shift custody to receiving system/person.
decisions.recommendedChoice: Use the factual shared-visibility/custody wording and state actual course submission expectations.
decisions.ownerSelection: Pending approval of notice; local-only/download boundary already required by task and TELEMETRY_CONTRACT.md
decisions.implementationStatus: Factual wording implemented; policy approval remains open.

decisions.options: Designated platform account custodian verifies dashboard settings, access, backups and retention
decisions.technicalConsequence: Repository has no explicit observability/logpush/log-retention setting; Worker has console.error on server faults. Account settings/provider defaults not inspected.
decisions.privacyResearchConsequence: Network/provider records can include request information beyond the content-free application table.
decisions.recommendedChoice: Assign an accountable provider administrator to verify/document real settings before institutional/research use.
decisions.implementationStatus: External verification required; provider settings unchanged.
